channel.description: Recent content in Directors on IQSS Clone - Harvard Institute for Quantitative Social Science

item.title: Bonnie OBrien
item.description:
Bonnie OBrien

Director of Human Resources

Email: bobrien@iq.harvard.edu

Joined IQSS in 2012. Provides overall HR leadership in recruitment, employee relations, and organizational development. Previously worked at UC San Diego.

SPHR certified with 20+ years of HR experience. Currently pursuing a Masters in Industrial-Organizational Psychology.

Education: Bachelors in Liberal Arts; HR Management Certificate, UCSD

item.title: Brooke Moore
item.description:
Brooke Moore

Director of Sponsored Research Administration

Email: bmoore@iq.harvard.edu

Joined IQSS in 2014. Manages the sponsored research team, oversees financial management and research compliance, and provides pre-award support. Also serves as administrative lead on several scientific research programs.

Member of Harvards Board of First-Year Advisers.

Education: B.A. in Political Science and History, UW-Madison; M.B.A., UMass-Amherst

item.title: Ceilyn Boyd
item.description:
Ceilyn Boyd

Interim Director of Data Science and Product Research

Email: cboyd@iq.harvard.edu

Oversees software development process for the Dataverse Project, managing partnership and grant responsibilities. Previously established and led Harvard Library Research Data Services Program.

Prior technical career in software engineering and technical project management, specializing in scientific data visualization, computer graphics, and special effects. Former employers include SRI International, Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pacific Title and Art Studio, Mitsubishi Electric, and BBN Corporation.

item.title: Debi Kleiman
item.description:
Debi Kleiman

Director, IQSS Startup Foundry

Email: dkleiman@iq.harvard.edu

Leads the IQSS Startup Foundry, catalyzing faculty-led innovation and commercialization. Career includes leadership at HBSs D^3 Startup Foundry, The Players Impact, and founding The Upside Angels.

Previously Executive Director of Babson Colleges Blank Center for Entrepreneurship. Author of “First Pitch: Winning Money, Mentors and More for Your Startup.”

Education: BS, Cornell; MBA, Harvard Business School

item.title: Elizabeth Jackson
item.description:
Elizabeth Jackson

Executive Director of IQSS

Email: ejackson@iq.harvard.edu

Elizabeth Jackson joined IQSS in July 2022, coming from Greater Portland Health in Maine and Harvard TH Chan School of Public Healths Department of Global Health and Population. She previously served as Chief Administrative Officer of Greater Portland Health and has worked in health system strengthening across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.

Past affiliations include the World Health Organization, Yale Global Health Leadership Institute, and Harvard Global Health Institute.

item.title: Gary King
item.description:
Gary King

Director of IQSS; Albert J. Weatherhead III University Professor

Email: king@harvard.edu

One of 22 Harvard University Professors (the university most distinguished faculty position). Develops and applies empirical methods in social science research, from statistical theory to practical application.

Elected Fellow of 6 honorary societies, including the National Academy of Sciences (2010) and American Academy of Arts and Sciences (1998). Senior Science Advisor to WHO (1998-2003); Guggenheim Fellow (1994-1995). Over 125 journal articles, 15 open source software packages, and 8 books. Listed as the most cited political scientist of his cohort.

item.title: Glen Comiso
item.description:
Glen Comiso

Executive Director, Human Flourishing Program

Email: gcomiso@fas.harvard.edu

Glen oversees the Human Flourishing Program at IQSS, managing strategic vision, donor relations, partnerships, and operations. Previously served as Chief of Staff in MITs presidents office.

Also worked at Boston Consulting Group, led the Massachusetts Life Sciences Collaborative, and oversaw economic initiatives for the City of Boston.

Education: MBA, Wharton; BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, UC Berkeley

item.title: Jason Nemirow
item.description:
Jason Nemirow

Director, Program on Higher Education Research

Email: nemirow@fas.harvard.edu

Leads PHERs strategic development and research agenda at IQSS and oversees the Council for Academic Freedom at Harvard (CAFH), a 200+ member faculty association.

Earned his PhD in Experimental Cognitive Psychology at Harvard, researching how people evaluate altruism. NSF Graduate Research Fellow.

Education: PhD, Harvard; B.A. summa cum laude in Biopsychology, UC Santa Barbara

item.title: Len Wisniewski
item.description:
Len Wisniewski

Senior Director of Research Computing

Email: lwisniewski@iq.harvard.edu

Before IQSS, served as Engineering Manager for High Performance Computing at Sun Microsystems. Earlier roles at Acopia Networks (acquired by F5) and Thinking Machines (acquired by Sun). Focus on algorithms and file systems for parallel and distributed computers.

Teaches computer science and software security at Northeasterns Cybersecurity Masters program.

Education: B.A. in Mathematics and Computer Science, LaSalle University; Ph.D. in Computer Science, Dartmouth College

item.title: Rachel Franklin
item.description:
Rachel Franklin

Executive Director, Center for Geographic Analysis

Email: rachel_franklin@cga.harvard.edu

Dr. Franklin joined the CGA in March 2025 with over 20 years experience in GIS, spatial analysis, and quantitative methods. Her research focuses on sources and impacts of demographic change at multiple spatial scales.

Previously a full professor at Newcastle University, she also holds roles at the Alan Turing Institute and Brown University. She began her career in 2002 at the US Census Bureau.

item.title: Steven Worthington
item.description:
Steven Worthington

Director of Data Science Services

Email: sworthington@iq.harvard.edu

At IQSS since 2011. Expertise in Bayesian and frequentist inference, deep learning, phylogenetic methods, and geometric morphometrics. Programs in R and Python.

Originally from northern England; currently completing a masters in data science at Harvard.

Education: PhD in Biological Anthropology, New York University

item.title: Valerie OKane
item.description:
Valerie OKane

Director of Business Operations

Email: valerie_okane@harvard.edu

Leads business operations at IQSS, overseeing budget, contracts, compliance, and space. Began at Harvard in 1992 with roles across FAS Extension School, Kennedy School, and Harvard College Observatory.

Served as interim Executive Director at HCO (2021-2022).

Education: Masters in Business Management, Harvard; BS, Suffolk University
